answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent to bonded stake and a Semaphore identity commitment, then assigns a rate-limited nullifier and evaluation point in an epoch polynomial. Honest messages remain unlinkable in the meadow, while duplicate use of one point yields two Shamir shares of the signing secret; interpolation reveals the private key, and the protocol instantly slashes collateral. A prism of proofs and an opal audit trail make the penalty publicly verifiable.
